{{Top|leg}}
'''Asteroid billiards''' was a game played by some [[pilot]]s which involved using a ship's [[laser]]s to knock small [[asteroid]]s off course to collide with other asteroids. [[Emon Azzameen]] was known to play the game, and taught it to his younger brother, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]].
